meta.description: Free specific heat capacity converter for 4+ units including Joule/(kg·K), Kilojoule/(kg·K), Calorie/(g·°C). Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: J/(kg·K), BTU/(lb·°F). Convert between 4 specific heat capacity units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for specific heat capacity in this tool is **JkgK**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most specific heat capacity conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

- Lab work and material processing temperature setpoints.
- Industrial process control in mixed-unit environments.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
